summary: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a security vulnerability affecting Remote Access VPN and Mobile Access in certain security gateway product configurations. The company released a software update to address the issue, identified on June 4, 2026, and has observed unauthorized access in some customer environments. No material financial impact has been determined. This is a routine operational disclosure regarding a cybersecurity incident, not a special-situation corporate transaction. The filing serves as a regulatory update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a current report on Form 8-K for domestic issuers.
